r.name: Monarch's Way
r.description: approximate route of Charles II's escape

r.name: The Dramway
r.description: The route of a 19th century tramway that carried coal from Coalpit Heath down to the River Avon

r.name: Stanley Walk
r.description: The easiest walk. Follows attractive woodland rides, largely level and on grass.

r.name: Thames & Severn Way
r.description: Linking the Severn to the Thames following the route of the Stroudwater Navigation and Thames & Severn Canal as closely as possible using public rights of way. As the canals are restored, it will be updated to use the reinstated towpath wherever possible.

r.name: Little Avon Circuit
r.description: Much is on grass, but the riverside walk is steeper with roots and steps.
